scripts.prepare:mainnet: node scripts/prepare-addresses.js mainnet && graph build --network mainnet

scripts.prepare:sepolia: node scripts/prepare-addresses.js sepolia && graph build --network sepolia
scripts.prepare:berachain: node scripts/prepare-addresses.js berachain && graph build --network berachain
